column1: #mapping_set_description: Correspondences from BRIDGE observed_property values (BERVO terms and BRIDGE-issued property IDs) to MIxS and METPO terms, asserted by BRIDGE where BERVO does not already carry them. First pass, 2026-10-07; BERVO release 2026-09-25, MIxS main at 6a2a6edd6.

column7: MIxS pH is the pH of a sample; BERVO pH is general.
BERVO Nitrate names the substance; MIxS nitrate is its concentration in a sample.
MIxS temperature is the temperature of a sample.
No BERVO term for depth of a sample.
METPO models this as a data property, not a class.
